name: Lighting fixtures
path: Lighting fixtures

name: Static and manually focused
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused

name: Profile / ellipsoidal (ERS)
definition: Shutter/gobo image-forming theatre profile; fixed or zoom lens.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Profile / ellipsoidal (ERS)

name: Fresnel wash
definition: Stepped Fresnel optic, soft-edged wash; source technology is a facet.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Fresnel wash

name: Plano-convex / pebble-convex (PC)
definition: Actual PC optic, not an ERS used as a substitute.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Plano-convex / pebble-convex (PC)

name: PAR and compact wash
definition: Conventional PAR bodies and LED PAR-style washes; lamp type remains a facet.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > PAR and compact wash

name: Cyclorama / asymmetric wall wash
definition: Dedicated cyc/floor-wall optics; striplight use tags may overlap.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Cyclorama / asymmetric wall wash

name: Flood / scoop / area light
definition: Broad area illumination; worklight and house-light application tags are separate.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Flood / scoop / area light

name: Pinspot / fixed beam / ACL
definition: Fixed narrow-beam function, distinct from audience blinder.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Pinspot / fixed beam / ACL

name: Linear batten / striplight
definition: Rigid linear source; independently addressable pixels are a capability.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Linear batten / striplight

name: Luminous tube
definition: Visible tubular source; integral or separate controller specified per product.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Luminous tube

name: Flexible pixel tape / scenic pixels
definition: Flexible tape or distributed pixel modules; driver is a separate dependency.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Flexible pixel tape / scenic pixels

name: Practical / decorative / handheld
definition: Visible lamps, bulbs and practical luminaires. Bulb-only records explicitly exclude socket/shade.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Practical / decorative / handheld

name: Dedicated UV / blacklight
definition: Purpose-built UV effect fixture; an RGBWAUV wash is not automatically a dedicated UV fixture.
path: Lighting fixtures > Static and manually focused > Dedicated UV / blacklight

name: Automated lighting
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting

name: Framing profile
definition: Automated image-forming fixture with framing shutters.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Framing profile

name: Spot / gobo projector
definition: Moving image-forming spotlight without a primary framing-profile designation.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Spot / gobo projector

name: Wash
definition: Moving soft coverage, including multi-emitter zoom wash.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Wash

name: Beam
definition: Moving narrow-beam aerial effect.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Beam

name: Beam / spot / wash hybrid
definition: Manufacturer identifies multi-role hybrid optical system.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Beam / spot / wash hybrid

name: Moving batten / multi-head bar
definition: Motorized linear fixture or coordinated array, not merely a manually tilted batten.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Moving batten / multi-head bar

name: Moving-mirror scanner
definition: Fixed body with motorized mirror; not a moving-head yoke.
path: Lighting fixtures > Automated lighting > Moving-mirror scanner

name: Manually operated followspot
definition: Operator steers the light; optional DMX intensity does not imply motorized pan/tilt.
path: Lighting fixtures > Manually operated followspot

name: Visible and audience effects
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects

name: Strobe
definition: Dedicated flash/strobe system; hybrid blinder capability kept as a use tag.
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects > Strobe

name: Audience blinder
definition: Audience-facing punch/tungsten-style glow role, distinct from ACL beam arrays.
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects > Audience blinder

name: Mirror ball / reflective effect
definition: Passive reflective object; motor and pinspots are separate products.
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects > Mirror ball / reflective effect

name: Mirror-ball motor
definition: Dedicated effect rotation motor; not the mirror ball, a chain hoist or an engineered lifting system.
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects > Mirror-ball motor

name: Show laser projector
definition: Physical projector only. No exposure model, show output, compliance or operator authorization is supplied.
path: Lighting fixtures > Visible and audience effects > Show laser projector

name: Atmosphere and air movement
path: Atmosphere and air movement

name: Fog / smoke-look generator
definition: Heated fog-fluid appliance; smoke is a search alias, not proof of combustion.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Fog / smoke-look generator

name: Water-based hazer / fazer
definition: Haze-producing machine with explicitly sourced water-based fluid/process.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Water-based hazer / fazer

name: Oil-based / atomizing hazer
definition: Oil-fluid hazer; record compressor or external gas dependency, do not assume an internal compressor.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Oil-based / atomizing hazer

name: Low-lying fog
definition: Chilled, ultrasonic or dry-ice systems share the low-fog role; process and consumables are facets.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Low-lying fog

name: Fog-fluid jet / geyser
definition: Dense fog jet, optionally LED-lit; not a genuine liquid-CO2 jet.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Fog-fluid jet / geyser

name: Effect fan / airflow appliance
definition: Separate fan for artistic air movement or atmosphere distribution.
path: Atmosphere and air movement > Effect fan / airflow appliance
